headline: US Employer Family Health Insurance Premiums Exceed $28,000 in 2026
summary: According to KFF's annual employer benefits survey, family health coverage premiums surpassed $28,000, with employees contributing an average of $7,471 annually—a 9% increase over 2025.
why: Healthcare represents one of the largest non-wage labor costs for American businesses, influencing profit margins and worker compensation negotiations.

impacts.name: US Corporate Employers
impacts.why: Accelerating healthcare premium inflation adds to overhead costs and crimps operating margins.
